info.title: Docmost API
info.description:
Docmost is an enterprise-ready collaborative wiki software for modern teams that you can self-host with full control over your data.

## Authentication

Pass an API key as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Response format

All endpoints use POST unless noted otherwise. Responses are wrapped as
`{ data, success, status }` except where noted (health, file downloads).

## Pagination

List endpoints return paginated results using cursor-based pagination. Pass an optional `limit` (1–100, default 20) to control page size. Cursors are opaque base64-encoded strings. The response shape is:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": 200,
  "data": {
    "items": [ ... ],
    "meta": {
      "limit": 20,
      "hasNextPage": true,
      "hasPrevPage": false,
      "nextCursor": "aWQ9MDE5OGVjMDYtZTAwY...",
      "prevCursor": null
    }
  }
}
```

To fetch the next page, pass the `nextCursor` value as `cursor` in your next request:

```json
{
  "limit": 20,
  "cursor": "aWQ9MDE5OGVjMDYtZTAwY..."
}
```

To go back, pass `prevCursor` as `beforeCursor` instead:

```json
{
  "limit": 20,
  "beforeCursor": "aWQ9MDE5OGVjMDYtZTAwY..."
}
```

## Enterprise features

Some features require an enterprise license or cloud plan. Those endpoints answer 403 when the workspace licence does not cover them.

post.description:
System property types (`createdAt`, `lastEditedAt`, `lastEditedBy`, `formula`) cannot be set via `type`. The accepted `typeOptions` shape depends on `type` - see BasePropertyTypeOptions.

Changing `type` converts existing cell values. Converting an id-based type to text resolves the ids to their display names, so a `status` cell holding `optgkcxdjh3j` becomes the string `Done`. On a base with enough rows the conversion runs in the background: the response carries a `jobId`, the property carries `pendingType`, and writes to it are rejected until it clears.

post.description:
Supports a compound `filter` tree and up to 5 `sorts`. The filter tree may nest 5 levels deep and hold 50 nodes in total.

Cursors are only valid for the exact `filter` and `sorts` they were issued under - filtered and unfiltered listing use different cursor encodings. Start a fresh page whenever the query changes instead of reusing `nextCursor`.

`references` is always present, as `{"users": {}, "pages": {}}` when there is nothing to expand.

withReferences.summary: Mixed cell types, with the referenced users and pages expanded

post.description:
`cells` may be omitted entirely to create an empty row. Any property with a `defaultValue` in its `typeOptions` is seeded automatically, and formula properties are evaluated, so the returned row can hold cells you did not send.

Values are validated against each property's type. `null` clears a cell. Keys must be property ids on this base - an unknown id fails the whole write with 400. Computed properties (`createdAt`, `lastEditedAt`, `lastEditedBy`, `formula`) are ignored if sent. A property with a type conversion in progress rejects the write.

ErrorResponse.description: Errors are **not** wrapped in `{data, success, status}` - the response interceptor only maps successful responses, and there is no global exception filter. Two shapes occur depending on how the error was raised. The HTTP status line is authoritative in both; only the first shape repeats it in the body.

SelectTypeOptions.description: Options for `select`, `status`, and `multiSelect` properties. A cell may only reference a choice id present in `choices`, otherwise the write fails with 400.

defaultValue.description: A single choice id, or an array for `multiSelect`.

PersonTypeOptions.description: Options for `person` properties. `allowMultiple` also determines the stored cell shape.

allowMultiple.description: When true, cells hold an array of user ids; when false, a bare user id. Values sent in the other shape are coerced.

FormulaTypeOptions.description: Options for `formula` properties. The `ast` is validated by the formula parser rather than by this schema.

source.description: Formula expression as typed by the user.

ast.description: Parsed expression tree. Opaque at the API layer.

EmptyTypeOptions.description: Options for `file`, `page`, `createdAt`, `lastEditedAt`, and `lastEditedBy` properties, which take no configuration.

BasePropertyTypeOptions.description:
Configuration for a property, keyed off the property's `type`. Unknown keys are preserved rather than rejected.

| type | schema |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | TextTypeOptions |
| `longText` | LongTextTypeOptions |
| `number` | NumberTypeOptions |
| `date` | DateTypeOptions |
| `checkbox` | CheckboxTypeOptions |
| `url` | UrlTypeOptions |
| `email` | EmailTypeOptions |
| `select`, `status`, `multiSelect` | SelectTypeOptions |
| `person` | PersonTypeOptions |
| `formula` | FormulaTypeOptions |
| `file`, `page`, `createdAt`, `lastEditedAt`, `lastEditedBy` | EmptyTypeOptions |

BaseCellValue.description:
A cell value, whose accepted JSON shape is determined by the owning property's `type`. `null` clears the cell.

| type | accepted value |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string, max 1000 chars |
| `longText` | string, max 25000 chars |
| `number` | number |
| `checkbox` | boolean |
| `url` | string, valid URL |
| `email` | string, valid email |
| `date` | string |
| `select`, `status` | one choice id, which must exist in the property's `choices` |
| `multiSelect` | array of choice ids, max 100, de-duplicated on write, each must exist in `choices` |
| `person` | user id, or array of user ids (max 100) when the property sets `allowMultiple` |
| `page` | page id |
| `file` | array of file objects, max 50 |
| `createdAt`, `lastEditedAt`, `lastEditedBy`, `formula` | not writable - these are computed and silently ignored if sent |

BaseCells.description: Map of property id to cell value. Keys must be ids of properties on this base; an unknown key fails the write with 400.

BaseFilterOperator.description:
Comparison operator. Which operators are valid depends on the property's type:

| property types | operators |
| --- | --- |
| `text`, `longText`, `url`, `email` | `eq`, `neq`, `contains`, `ncontains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` |
| `number` | `eq`, `neq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` |
| `date`, `createdAt`, `lastEditedAt` | `eq`, `before`, `after`, `onOrBefore`, `onOrAfter`, `isWithin`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` |
| `checkbox` | `eq`, `neq`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` |
| `select`, `status` | `eq`, `neq`, `any`, `none`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` |
| `multiSelect`, `file` | `eq`, `neq`, `any`, `all`, `none`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` |
| `person` | `eq`, `neq`, `any`, `none`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` - plus `all` when the property sets `allowMultiple` |
| `page`, `lastEditedBy` | `eq`, `neq`, `any`, `none`, `isEmpty`, `isNotEmpty` |

A condition using an operator its property does not support matches nothing rather than erroring.

BaseDateOperand.description: Operand for a date comparison, discriminated by `mode`. Comparisons are day-granular in UTC. `range` pairs with the `isWithin` operator; the other modes resolve to a single instant.

value.description: Operand, omitted for `isEmpty` and `isNotEmpty`. Scalar for comparison operators, an array for `any` / `all` / `none`, and a BaseDateOperand object for every date comparison.

BaseFilterNode.description: Either a single condition or a nested group.

BaseViewConfig.description: View configuration. Unknown keys are preserved. `groupByPropertyId`, `hiddenChoiceIds`, and `choiceOrder` apply to kanban views only.

propertyWidths.description: Map of property id to column width in pixels.

hiddenChoiceIds.description: Collapsed kanban columns. Accepts choice ids plus the `__no_value` sentinel for the ungrouped column.

choiceOrder.description: Kanban column order. Accepts choice ids plus the `__no_value` sentinel.

BaseReferencedPage.description: Display data for a page referenced by a `page` cell.

BaseRowReferences.description:
Display data for the ids appearing in this page of rows, so a client can render them without a follow-up lookup. Keyed by id.

`users` covers every row's `creatorId` and `lastUpdatedById` plus the values of any `person` cells. `pages` covers the values of any `page` cells. Pages the caller cannot view are omitted.

jobId.description: Set when changing `type` queued a background job to convert existing cell values, which happens when there are enough rows that doing it inline would be slow. While that job runs the property carries `pendingType`, and writes to it are rejected. `null` means no conversion was needed or it completed inline.

BaseViewConfigPatch.description: A patch, not a replacement. Keys you omit keep their current value, keys you set are overwritten, and a key set to `null` is *removed* from the stored config.

propertyWidths.description: Map of property id to column width in pixels.

hiddenChoiceIds.description: Collapsed kanban columns. Accepts choice ids plus the `__no_value` sentinel.

choiceOrder.description: Kanban column order. Accepts choice ids plus the `__no_value` sentinel.
